reason: Adds a show_image tool and web UI integration that renders referenced local images inline in the conversation flow while returning text-only tool results.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 对话流中通过 show_image 工具将本地图片以内嵌卡片形式显示。
summaries.en: Displays local images as inline cards in the DeepSeek Harness Web conversation flow through a show_image tool.

capabilities: Reads image files from paths supplied to the show_image tool
Validates image format, size, and dimensions
Serves stored images through a plugin HTTP endpoint
Renders image cards inline in the web chat flow
